summary: Republic Power Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement with Dune Equity Holdings LLC, closed July 24, 2026. The company issued a $285,000 convertible promissory note (including $25,000 original issue discount), 12% interest, 12-month maturity, convertible at 80% of the three lowest trading prices over the prior ten days, plus 53,000 Class A ordinary shares as commitment shares. A second tranche of $285,000 is conditional on registration effectiveness and Nasdaq compliance. This is a standard dilutive financing, not a special situation; no premium, tender, or strategic event is involved. Watch for registration statement timing and potential conversion-related dilution.
